wordle.question: I'm working on a Wordle video.  Other than the optimal strategy (which will definitely be in there), what would you most like to see?
options: Choosing words that are hard to guess
Other (eg other variants, different word list). Post in comments
wordle.source: transcribed by hand from a screenshot of the live poll (dark mode, logged in as the channel), 2026-09-29 12:14. YouTube's Data API has no community-post endpoint, so there is no automated route; percentages and the vote count are exactly as YouTube displayed them (rounded by YouTube).
